method.bw95: frequency below which 95% of Welch (nperseg 2048) power lies
method.occupancy: fraction of 513 STFT bins with layer value >= 0.12, per frame
method.braille:
(interpretation, documented):
  occupancy(layer, frame) = fraction of the 513 STFT bins where layer >= 0.12 (cube threshold)
  A 1-second slice -> two columns (first half-second, second half-second).
  Rows top->bottom: quality, confidence, tonality, signal (cube stack, signal at bottom).
  Dot raised when the half-second mean occupancy of that layer exceeds that layer's
  median half-second occupancy over the whole clip.
  Unicode braille: left column dots 1,2,3,7 (top->bottom), right column 4,5,6,8;
  char = U+2800 + sum(bit[d]) with bit = {1:0x01,2:0x02,3:0x04,4:0x08,5:0x10,6:0x20,7:0x40,8:0x80}.
